The '''Duel on Rattatak''' was a brief skirmish between [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] in the [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]] arena known as [[The Cauldron]]. After a fierce lightsaber duel, Anakin eventually defeated the [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] assailant.

==Behind the scenes==
This duel only appeared in the flash game ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars: Planetary Forces]]''. Since the other events covered in the game (The [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]] and the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)/Legends|Battle of Mon Calamari]]) occurred around the same time, and the [[Duel on Yavin 4]] took place during the later stages of the former, its canonicity is ambiguous.
